@@U04322@@
and hold your rings as you dip your fingers and give me your sign of approval.

@@U04324@@
I find it difficult just now to turn to festive thoughts. But no matter. A joyous beginning is always best.

@@U04325@@
(To the THIRD PRINCE.)

@@U04326@@
You, sir, I appoint my Lord Steward. Yours is to oversee the hunt, the poultry yards and the farm. And then to prepare with skill and consummate care the choicest delicacies a season has to offer.

@@U04328@@
I shall happily forego food, Majesty, till any given dish has met your approval. The kitchen staff and I will conspire together to procure the choicest viands from distant regions, and well before their seasons. And yet, Sire, such luxuries mean little to you who prefer the nourishing and simple.

@@U04330@@
(To the FOURTH PRINCE.)

@@U04331@@
Our unfailing topic being feasts and festivities, you, young hero, I appoint my Lord Cupbearer. It is your charge to see that our cellars are always well stocked with the finest. And be moderate, you hear? Don't let opportunity get the better of you.

@@U04333@@
Give youth a chance, Majesty, and it will achieve maturity before you know it. I, too, see myself at that great feast,
translation:
@@U04322@@
握住你的戒指，蘸上手指，向我表示你的认可。

@@U04324@@
我发现现在很难转向节日的想法。但没关系。快乐的开始总是最好的。

@@U04325@@
（对三皇子。）

@@U04326@@
您，先生，我任命我的管家大人。你的职责是监督狩猎、家禽饲养场和农场。然后以精湛的技艺和精湛的细心准备当季最美味的佳肴。

@@U04328@@
陛下，我会很乐意放弃食物，直到任何一道菜都得到您的认可。我和厨房工作人员将共同商量，在季节到来之前从遥远的地区采购最优质的食材。然而，陛下，对于喜欢营养和简单的您来说，这样的奢侈毫无意义。

@@U04330@@
（对四王子。）

@@U04331@@
我们永恒的话题是盛宴和庆祝活动，你，年轻的英雄，我任命我的酒政大人。您有责任确保我们的酒窖始终备有最好的葡萄酒。而且要温和，听到了吗？不要让机会战胜你。

@@U04333@@
